en: The image depicts the ornate interior of a historic mosque, with a beautifully carved wooden minbar (pulpit) at the center. The walls are adorned with Islamic calligraphy and geometric patterns. There are two large candlesticks flanking a Qur'an stand (rihal) on a carpeted floor. The architectural style features arched windows with intricate latticework, and the overall atmosphere suggests a place of worship.
